newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algerian, Tunisian ministers meet on security.
newsitem.headline: Algerian, Tunisian ministers meet on security.

text.p: The interior ministers of Algeria and Tunisia met in Algiers on Sunday to discuss security issues, the official Algerian news agency APS said.
Algeria's Mustapha Ben Mansour said the two neighbours needed to tackle the security issue "more than ever".
Algerian security forces have been locked in a five-year conflict with Moslem fundamentalists during which about 60,000 people have been killed.
Tunisian minister Mohamed Jegham, who arrived in Algiers on Saturday, and Ben Mansour stressed the need to strengthen bilateral relations, APS said.
Jegham visited the headquarters of security units and watched martial arts and self-defence exercises, the agency said.
